parameters.query: SELECT active_corpus_version, embedding_profile_id, config_revision, minimum_similarity, retrieval_limit, context_bound, output_bound, chat_model, embedding_model, embedding_dimension FROM rag.rag_settings WHERE id = 1

SELECT source_name, source_hash, chunk_index, content, embedding_profile_id, embedding <=> $3::vector AS distance FROM rag.documents WHERE corpus_version = $1 AND embedding_profile_id = $2 ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT $4
